backend/main.mo: Defines storage mixin usage and two public types for render rules and legacy Genesis Craft previews.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries describing image processing, discard rules, and IPFS pipeline requirements with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten summaries of numerous frontend files covering UI pages, components, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Sets global Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light/dark themes and applies base styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app defining project types, persistence logic, navigation, and lazy-loaded pages.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Alert-dialog component for confirming destructive actions using shared confirmation store.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: Dialog for creating a new project, capturing name, symbol, size, and pixel-art mode before invoking a creation callback.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: Clickable tile that triggers creation of a new project with a plus-icon UI.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: Dialog for editing an existing project's name, symbol, size, and pixel-art mode with validation.
Displays a project's summary card with metadata and action buttons for opening, settings, and deletion.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer with attribution and link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with navigation, project info, mobile menu, and save-status display.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Small tooltip wrapper showing hover/focus-triggered popover content.
frontend/src/components/icons/index.tsx: Exports a set of lightweight inline SVG icon React components replacing lucide-react imports.
frontend/src/components/MotionIconButton: Button component with motion/animation classes for interactive icon actions.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Provides a dialog explaining how to obtain a Pinata JWT token, including warnings and step-by-step instructions.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Displays brief save-state text based on a status prop, maintaining fixed width to avoid layout shift.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Handles locking, unlocking, and uploading NFT collections to IPFS, updating project state and showing progress or errors.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Renders buttons to switch between compact and grid view modes in the vault UI.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity, refetching queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Provides a Zustand-powered confirmation dialog store and a helper that returns a promise for destructive confirmations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider handling AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Validates a Pinata JWT key with debouncing, returning status and messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file for future query-related hooks.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, global theme variables, motion settings, and custom utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: Implements the NFT builder UI, handling image layering, previews, uploads, and token management.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard lists projects, handles creation, opening, updating, and deletion, and manages dialogs for creating and editing project settings.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Preview renders layered trait combinations on a canvas, validates rules, supports shuffling traits, and applies pixel or smooth rendering modes.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: RarityWorkshop edits trait weights per layer, auto‑normalizes values, and updates locked or adjusted weights through project state.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Rules manages creation, editing, duplication, and deletion of trait compatibility rules using modal forms and project updates.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings configures project metadata, blockchain mapping, Pinata keys, and Solana creator shares, updating project settings accordingly.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Complex UI for generating, viewing, filtering, sorting, and exporting NFT outputs, including ZIP creation, worker message handling, rarity computation, and view controls.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: Editor interface for creating, editing, reordering, and deleting layers and traits, with validation, dialogs, and project update callbacks.
Converts uploaded images into square PNGs at a target resolution using scale‑and‑crop, with optional pixel-art mode.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Uploads generated NFT images and metadata to Pinata/IPFS, builds metadata with IPFS URIs, and reports staged progress.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Generates preview and final metadata objects for multiple blockchain formats, resolving naming templates and building IPFS or local image references.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Provides single-key project persistence with atomic saves, legacy cleanup, storage size checks, and simple load utilities.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Provides helpers to validate Pinata JWT tokens and upload files or JSON to IPFS, including sanitizing filenames.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines message types, data structures, and type guards for communication between the NFT generator worker and UI.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Exports a helper that yields to the browser event loop to keep the UI responsive during long tasks.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Implements a Web Worker for NFT generation, handling trait selection, rule checks, DNA creation, optional image compositing, and metadata building.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, spacings, typography, animations, and dark mode settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, known issues, and feature requests related to ensuring processed Forge images are uploaded to Pinata.
